candidates.snippet: China’s solar capacity has overtaken coal fired power for the first time, reaching 1.286 billion kW by end July 2026. ☀️ Solar now accounts for 31.5% of total installed power capacity, while China produces about 80% of the world’s PV modules. 🌱 #CleanEnergy #SolarPower https://t.
